_README: Hardware specifications. Every block carries a 'status' field. 'verified' = taken from a cited primary source with a quote. 'provisional' = used only to develop the code; the paper build (src/paperdata.py) REFUSES to emit a table containing any provisional value. Nothing provisional may reach the PDF.

canon_eos_200d.model: Canon EOS 200D (EOS Rebel SL2 / EOS Kiss X9)
canon_eos_200d._serial_note: The observer supplied the body serial number to confirm the exact model; it identifies a physical device and is deliberately not published.
canon_eos_200d.source: Canon official SPECIFICATION SHEET, "Canon EOS 200D Black + EF-S 18-55mm f/4-5.6 IS STM", product specification PDF (https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/91W7rjMZNiS.pdf), text extracted directly.
canon_eos_200d.quote: IMAGE SENSOR TYPE 22.3mm x 14.9mm CMOS | COLOUR FILTER TYPE Primary Colour | EFFECTIVE PIXELS: STILL IMAGES Approx 24.2 megapixels | LOW-PASS FILTER Built-in/Fixed | IMAGE SIZE JPEG 3:2: (L) 6000 x 4000

wide.actual_focal_derivation: Equivalent focal length 24 mm divided by the crop factor. Sensor "type" diagonal taken as 16/X mm for a 1/X inch format, a convention checked on the wide module (1/1.28 in -> 12.5 mm, matching the published active area of its 50 MP sensor).

tele.actual_focal_derivation: Equivalent focal length 50 mm divided by the crop factor. Sensor "type" diagonal taken as 16/X mm for a 1/X inch format, a convention checked on the wide module (1/1.28 in -> 12.5 mm, matching the published active area of its 50 MP sensor).

ultrawide.actual_focal_derivation: Equivalent focal length 15 mm divided by the crop factor. Sensor "type" diagonal taken as 16/X mm for a 1/X inch format, a convention checked on the wide module (1/1.28 in -> 12.5 mm, matching the published active area of its 50 MP sensor).

xiaomi_13t_pro.source: Xiaomi official specification page https://www.mi.com/global/product/xiaomi-13t-pro-leica/specs/ . The page returns HTTP 403 to automated retrieval, so the values were obtained through a search index that quotes that page verbatim; they are therefore labelled SECONDARY rather than primary.
xiaomi_13t_pro.quote: Wide camera: 50MP, 1/1.28" sensor size, f/1.9 aperture, 24mm equivalent focal length, OIS, 7P lens. Telephoto: 50MP, f/1.9, 1/2.88", 0.61 um pixels, 50mm equivalent, 5P lens. Ultra-wide: 12MP, 1/3.06", f/2.2, 5P lens.

tamron_16_300_B016.model: TAMRON 16-300/3,5-6,3 Di II VC PZD Macro (model B016)
tamron_16_300_B016.quote: Optical construction: '16 Elementos' and '12 Grupos'; filter diameter '67 mm.'; diaphragm '7 red.'; minimum apertures '22-40'; maximum aperture by focal length: 18mm f/3.5, 30mm f/4, 35mm f/4.5, 45mm f/5, 80mm f/5.6, 150mm f/6.3
tamron_16_300_B016.transmittance_note: No T-stop or transmittance measurement is published for this lens. The paper therefore treats tau as a bounded parameter: tau = 1.0 is used for all SAFETY limits (the conservative choice, since a perfectly transmitting lens delivers the most energy to the sensor), and tau = 0.85 is quoted alongside as a plausible nominal for a 24-air-glass-surface multicoated design. No conclusion in the paper depends on which is used; the sensitivity is reported explicitly.
tamron_16_300_B016.source_manufacturer: Tamron official product page https://www.tamron.com/global/consumer/lenses/b016/ confirms "16 elements in 12 groups"; the maximum-aperture-vs-focal-length breakpoints come from the reference supplied by the observer.

eye.focal_length_source: ICNIRP 2013, eqn 2: Gullstrand eye, f = 17 mm
eye.pupil_source: ICNIRP 2013: 7 mm for the dark-adapted eye and approximately 3 mm for bright light conditions
